text:
Alice H.: kicking off — canary 2026-03-15 12:02 UTC showing p95 latency regression after runtime PR #8423 landed. Can we hold rollouts? /cc @Carla (runtime) @Erin (sre)
Ben (infra): saw the spike on dashboards, looks correlated with kernel switch to int4 matmul. p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~280ms on gen workloads.
Carla (runtime): thanks. I'm running a micro-benchmark now for the same model+seq. Will attach outputs.
Alice H.: canary paused by pipeline, but traffic still routed for verification. need sign-off before resume.
Carla (runtime): micro-bench results: `./bench --model=/models/clone-3b --seq=512 --iters=200` -> median 130ms, p95 265ms. reproduces locally on g5. I've opened perf flame: http://perf.internal/abc123
Erin (sre): what's the failure mode? increased kernel latency or stalls?
Carla (runtime): looks like longer matmul kernel tail due to non-optimal tiling at seq>256. Also KV cache copy increases with quantized path.
Frank (eng-releases): suggested mitigations? rollback to prior kernel or adjust canary weight?
Ben (infra): we can throttle canary to 5% and collect profile pairs. currently at 15%.
Alice H.: prefer to hold automatically until we triage — what do we need to unblock?
Carla (runtime): need a short trace from canary nodes: `sudo perf record -F 99 -a -g -- sleep 30` and the model config used. Also need the exact request seq distribution.
Ops-bot: @Carla requested perf traces from canary nodes. To upload, use `/upload-perf <node-id> <artifact>`
Dave S.: I can run traces on two canary nodes in eu-west-1; will upload to perf bucket.
Ben (infra): also dump `nvidia-smi dmon` per-node for 1 minute, helps rule out thermal throttling.
Carla (runtime): thanks. If traces show kernel-level stall I can stripe a hotfix to kernel parameters and push a canary patch. If not, fallback is rollback.
Erin (sre): do we have SLA for canary hold? ops, any customer impact?
Alice H.: no customer-facing incidents yet. internal SLAs allow up to 2h hold for safety.
Dave S.: uploaded traces: s3://perf/redwood/canary/1782104520/dave-node1.tar.gz and node2
Carla (runtime): downloading now. initial grep shows `cudaMemcpy` spikes aligning with p95 windows. pushing a small PR to reduce memcpys in quant path: #8450
Frank (eng-releases): can we test PR on canary nodes with shadow traffic?
Ben (infra): yes, will route 10% shadow and 1% live if Carla needs it.
Alice H.: Erin, do you approve running the hotfix as canary patch (#8450) with monitoring for 30m then ramp?
Erin (sre): approve with condition: realtime alert on p95 > 200ms reverts to immediate pause and rollback. Set pager.
Alice H.: approved. @Ben please start deployment window 12:45 UTC.
Ben (infra): rolling patch now. Deploy-bot: starting canary rollout for runtime:pr-8450 (10% shadow, 1% live).
Deploy-bot: canary step 1 complete. route: shadow 10% -> nodes a,b. live 1% -> node b.
Dave S.: watching traces — initial results show p95 dropping to ~140ms on node b.
Carla (runtime): telemetry looks good. keeping watch on KV cache and memcpy counts.
Ops-bot: automated watch: no p95 alert triggers in first 15m.
Erin (sre): continuing watch. If any sign of regression, I will trigger rollback.
Alice H.: thanks everyone. Marking canary as 'hotfix-deployed' pending final 30m window.
Frank (eng-releases): will document decision in release notes. cc @people-ops for postmortem if needed.
Carla (runtime): looks stable at 30m. recommend resuming rollout to 50% after 10m.
Erin (sre): approve ramp to 50% with same alert thresholds.
Ben (infra): ramping to 50%.
Deploy-bot: ramp complete.
Alice H.: closing thread. follow up: Carla to open perf follow-up ticket with root cause and fix plan.
Carla (runtime): will do: JIRA RED-3019. thanks all :tada:
